'''Nardi Shodu''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she visited the planet's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]], approaching the crash site of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|airspeeder]]. Shodu later visited the Outlander on an errand with the woman [[Booton Piton]] after Wesell ran in to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|hide]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
[[File:NardiBooton-AOTC.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Nardi Shodu entered the Outlander Club with Booton Piton.]]
Nardi Shodu was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Shodu and the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="AOTC" /> woman [[Booton Piton]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> approached the crash site of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]]'s<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|''Koro-2'' all-environment exodrive airspeeder]]<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> in the Uscru Entertainment District, shortly after the hunter's [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AOTC" />

Shortly after,<ref name="AOTC" /> Shodu traveled on an errand to the Outlander Club with Piton.<ref name="Insider" /> The women entered the club [[Limb/Legends|arm]] in arm just in front of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who were there to capture Wesell. Shodu and Piton then walked behind a<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> in the club and later spent [[Time/Legends|time]] together near a<ref name="AOTC" /> [[MixRMastR]] [[Droid/Legends|robot]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]].<ref name="FF57">{{FactFile|57|ROB 1-4|Robo-Bartenders}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Being a Rodian,<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> her<ref name="DB" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] added to the interplanetary feel of the club that night she visited.<ref name="FF96" /> Shodu had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="DB" /> Her first name, of interchangeable gender, meant "dramatic," and her second name meant "gracious" in a feminine context, and "vengeful" in a masculine context.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]</ref>

==Equipment==
On the night she visited the Uscru Entertainment District, Shodu wore a greenish-brown [[Clothing/Legends|coat]] over a gray shirt, gray pants, and black shoes.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Nardi_Shodu.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The StarWars.com Databank identified a different Rodian (pictured) as Nardi Shodu.]]
Nardi Shodu first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], and in a picture in its [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (video game)|video game adaptation]].<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="GBA">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' video game]]</ref> Both released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year2">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref><ref name="GBADate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2002/05/15/star-wars-episode-ii-attack-of-the-clones-3|text=Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones (GBA)|author=[https://www.ign.com/person/craig-ign Craig Harris]|date=2002-05-15|archivedate=20160325105351}}</ref> The Outlander Club scenes including Shodu, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra, were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Like most masked extras playing aliens, the extra playing Shodu was guided around by an extra playing a Human.<ref name="Insider" />

Prior to the film's release, the character was first pictured in the documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> Shodu was first identified in an image in "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases]]," a [[StarWars.com]] web article first published on [[May 2]], [[2003]].<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The character's entry in the StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] identified another Rodian in the Outlander Club scene as Shodu.<ref name="DB" />
